About Mountain Ready

Mountain Ready is your go-to brand for top-quality outdoor gear and survival essentials. We equip adventurers and outdoor enthusiasts with the tools they need to conquer the wilderness and be fully prepared for any challenge nature throws their way. Our products are designed for durability, reliability, and efficiency, ensuring our customers are always ready for their next adventure.

Why Become a Mountain Ready Affiliate?

As a Mountain Ready affiliate, you'll be promoting a brand that stands for adventure, preparedness, and resilience. Whether your audience is made up of seasoned hikers, survivalists, or outdoor newbies, our products are designed to meet their needs. By joining our affiliate program, you'll help your followers discover high-quality gear while earning a commission on every sale.

Benefits of Our Affiliate Program

  • 30-Day Cookie Window: Earn commissions on sales made within 30 days of the initial click, giving you ample time to convert leads into sales.
  • 5% Commission on All Sales: Enjoy a generous 5% commission on every sale made through your affiliate link or promo code. Whether it's a small accessory or a big-ticket item, you earn a share of the profit.
  • 7% Commission on First Order: If the customer is new to Mountain Ready, their first order earns you an enhanced commission of 7%.
  • Extended Commission Period (180 Days): A customer will automatically be connected to you as an affiliate once they make their first successful purchase. You'll receive a commission for all purchases made by that customer for 180 days.
  • Trusted Brand: Promote a brand known for its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, making it easier to build trust and drive conversions.
  • Easy Payouts: Receive your earnings quickly and securely through our hassle-free payment options, including Venmo, PayPal, and Zelle.

Join the Mountain Ready Affiliate Program today and start earning while helping others prepare for their next great adventure!

Mountain Ready Affiliate Program - Terms and Conditions

Welcome to Mountain Ready! We’re excited to have you join our Affiliate Program. These Terms and Conditions outline the rules and guidelines for affiliates who participate in our program. By participating in the Program, you agree to comply with these terms. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us if your registration is rejected.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon Codes

Affiliate links are automatically generated upon your registration. You may also generate custom links for specific products or collections. If a user clicks on another affiliate’s link and later clicks on yours, the most recent link (yours) will take precedence.

Affiliates may be assigned a unique coupon code, details of which will be clarified in the Dashboard. If a customer uses both your affiliate link and coupon code, you will receive a single commission. If you have not been assigned a branded coupon, you are not permitted to promote any coupon code.

You may advertise our website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline through classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payment

When you refer a customer who makes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission based on the order value, excluding additional fees such as taxes and shipping costs. To receive a commission, you must provide your payment details in the Settings section. Payment schedules will be available on the Affiliate Guide page.

Commissions are paid out only for successfully completed transactions. The status of your commissions can be viewed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be eligible for commission payments.

4. Marketing Tools

We provide promotional media such as banners, logos, and specific collection promotions through the Marketing Tools tab. You can download these media files or get the HTML embed code to share on your affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, you can invite others to join the affiliate program as your downline affiliates. If a downline affiliate generates an order, you, as the upline affiliate, will receive a network commission based on the merchant settings.

To invite others, share your network link. Any affiliate who signs up through your link will become your downline affiliate.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track users who click on your affiliate links. Cookies must be enabled on the user's device for tracking and commission purposes. If a user does not allow cookies or clears them, we cannot track their activity, and no commission will be earned for that user.

The cookie duration is specified on the Affiliate registration form. Within this period, any orders made by the customer after clicking your link will automatically generate a commission for you, without the need for the customer to click the link again.

7. Removal from the Affiliate Program

If you wish to be removed from the Affiliate Program, you can do so by contacting us at affiliates@mountainready.online.

Thank you for taking the time to read through these important Terms and Conditions. We look forward to a successful partnership and wish you all the best in your affiliate endeavors. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at any time.
